items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the trumpet, George McCormick. Just one trumpet... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: See, cause when the golf left the band, I played tenor a while. Mm-hmm. And then, uh... When oil left the band, then we got olive alcohol. That's right. Mm-hmm. I see.
Did we get the trumpets in the band, or...? Well, the trumpet, George McCormick. Just one trumpet, and one trumpet, one trombone.
That's right. And who did you say the trombone was? I forgot. Raymond. Raymond Brown. Raymond Brown.
